summary: The revised claims accurately separate deterministic core checks, a real public pretrained text-interface check, and a two-update synthetic training-plumbing witness. A blocking path mismatch prevents the supplied fetcher output from entering train.py as documented; successful witness binaries and arrays are also outside the bounded evidence set.

blocking_defects.title: Fetcher and trainer disagree on download.json location
blocking_defects.details: fetch_text_encoder.py writes download.json to results/reimplementation_text while train.py requires encoder_path/download.json inside cache/text/distilbert-base-uncased. The documented fetch-to-train path cannot close without an extra manual file.
blocking_defects.required_correction: Use an explicit text_encoder_manifest config path or copy the completed manifest into the cache directory; add an end-to-end path-contract test.

scope.claim_ceiling: core implementation consistency, public text-interface compatibility, and reduced synthetic training-plumbing execution only

gt_provenance.details: No motion ground truth or quality target is used. Core and training tensors are explicitly synthetic; text verification is interface-only with public pretrained weights.

score_normalization.details: No model-output-normalized performance score exists. Feature statistics are fit on the training split only; losses are raw x0 MSE and load-balance components.

result_existence.details: All named files, internal numbers, manifest/config hashes, source hashes, and receipts are consistent. The bounded scope excludes cached checkpoint bytes, synthetic npy inputs, and model_000002.pt, so their recorded hashes cannot be independently rechecked here.

dead_code.details: Coverage now includes a full-size forward, real text adapter, and two optimizer updates. Online fetch, ASFO-enabled dataset weighting, research training, file-hash leakage rejection, evaluation, and physics paths remain unexecuted or unwitnessed.

scope.details: README claim boundaries are accurate, but the documented future train command depends on an undocumented cache-local download.json because of the path-contract blocker.

evaluation_type.details: None is a motion-quality, real-GT, simulation, or human evaluation.

eq_7.qualification: x0 loss primitive; author beta schedule remains unknown

eq_8_9.qualification: formula and multi-token chunk consistency checked; paper-unspecified attention details are disclosed

eq_10_11.qualification: literal arithmetic and zero-count semantics checked; actual mirroring is absent and ASFO training path is unwitnessed

eq_12.qualification: explicit fixed-mask inpainting reconstruction only; no GMT/simulation/MPJPE/PPO loop

eq_13_14.qualification: algebra and actual-denoiser null/negative paths checked with documented mask semantics

independent_proposals: linear beta schedule 0.0001 to 0.02 over 1000 steps

split_leakage.supported: Declared source_group and exact file-hash overlap across splits are rejected; normalization uses train only.
split_leakage.limit: Different derivatives of the same source are undetectable unless their manifest source_group agrees. Only source-group rejection has a direct negative witness.

claims.claim: Twelve deterministic core checks passed on exact current sources.
A recorded public pretrained DistilBERT revision passed the frozen text-interface test.
The public checkpoint is the authors exact checkpoint.
A full-size untrained denoiser accepts real token outputs and returns finite tensors.
Two reduced-model CPU optimizer updates completed on explicitly synthetic arrays.
The supplied standard fetch-to-train workflow is closed.
A full-size motion generator was trained or motion quality was evaluated.
The two loss rows demonstrate learning or convergence.
Declared source-group and identical-file overlap is rejected.
All semantic split leakage is eliminated.
Example optimizer, schedule, budget, and ASFO values reproduce author hyperparameters.

required_corrections: Reconcile fetch_text_encoder.py and train.py provenance-manifest paths and test the complete path contract.
Pre-pin the fetcher to an explicit revision and validate provenance status, repository, revision, and manifest hash in train.py.
Include or independently inventory the witness npy inputs, cached text bytes, and checkpoint in future bounded audits.
Add ASFO-enabled and exact-file-hash split-overlap tests.
Keep public-text and two-update outputs classified as interface/plumbing checks with no motion-quality interpretation.
